request.style: English, anthemic rock, strong raspy male vocal, overdriven electric guitars, bass guitar, pounding drums, organ swells, defiant and unshaken, 118 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Though the earth gives way beneath us and the mountains start to fall
Down into the heart of the sea, we will not fear at all
Let the waters roar and foam and the hills shake at their swell
We have found a stronger shelter than the walls in which we dwell

[Chorus]
God is our refuge and strength
A help in troubles, always to be found
The LORD of hosts is with us
The God of Jacob is our fortress

[Verse]
There's a river in the city and its streams run clear and wide
God is in her midst, she will not be shaken, he is at her side
Nations rage and kingdoms totter, at his voice the earth melts down
He breaks the bow and shatters spears and burns the chariots to the ground

[Chorus]
God is our refuge and strength
A help in troubles, always to be found
The LORD of hosts is with us
The God of Jacob is our fortress

[Bridge]
Be still, and know that I am God
I will be exalted among the nations
I will be exalted in the earth
Be still, and know that I am God

[Chorus]
God is our refuge and strength
A help in troubles, always to be found
The LORD of hosts is with us
The God of Jacob is our fortress

[Outro]
Be still, and know that I am God
The LORD of hosts is with us
